identity.name: Whitmore Estates
identity.notes: Gated new estate home community by Lennar in Lake Worth, FL (10110 Ruidoso Road, ZIP 33449), conveniently located near Wellington, the "Winter Equestrian Capital of the World." Actively selling with homes priced $1,199,000–$2,799,990. Features a modern clubhouse (indoor lounge, covered outdoor area, fire pit, barbecue area) and a tropical swimming pool with cabana area. No HOA fee amounts, demographics, or facility distances were stated in the content. Note: the content also includes a profile for a separate "Whitmore Estates Homeowners Association, Inc." in Palm Beach Gardens, FL 33410 (single-family, gated), which appears to be a different community and contained no fee/amenity/demographic data.

fees.note: Every home is in an HOA with a monthly fee covering amenities and common-area maintenance (gated entry, clubhouse, lawns); no dollar amount published on any page read. A Lennar agent's Facebook video describes it as a 'comparatively low HOA payment' (unverified, no amount). No CDD/special assessment found. Note: 'Whitmore Estates Homeowners Association, Inc.' in Palm Beach Gardens 33410 (hoa-agent.com) is a different community and was excluded. Community is new construction (2025-2027), so fee schedules may not yet be public; confirm with Lennar/HOA at purchase. Confidence 0.55 (reputable realtor site, no amount).
HOA maintains common areas, gated entry, clubhouse, and fully maintained lawns (maintenance included in dues per FAQ). No separate recurring charges identified. Confidence 0.55.
